parameters.name: ApplicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the edge application. On the **Application Management** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target application name to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: ApplicationVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the edge application.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
